title: Unbalanced Feistel Networks for Unpredictable Sources
summary: The source presents the construction as a conjectural route to the unpredictable-source transformation; whether it achieves that transformation remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Does a heavily unbalanced Feistel network with $\Omega(n)$ rounds achieve the transformation for unpredictable sources?

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography concerning Feistel-network constructions and transformations for unpredictable sources.
parameters: Heavily unbalanced Feistel network, the conjectured construction
One-bit round outputs, the round-output structure
Unpredictable sources, the source class for the target transformation
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the conjectured heavily unbalanced Feistel network achieves the transformation for unpredictable sources.

progress.summary: The source explicitly frames the claim as a conjecture, proposing a heavily unbalanced Feistel network with Omega(n) rounds to achieve the transformation for unpredictable sources.
citation_labels: Pratik Soni et al., Public-Seed Pseudorandom Permutations
